$comment: Layered 2D puppets built from the dedicated pose renders (scripts/prepare-puppets.mjs). Coordinates are ORIGINAL source pixels (before mirroring); `mirror: true` flips the image and every coordinate. Layers are listed back → front; each pixel belongs to the front-most layer whose polygon contains it (a layer without a polygon takes the rest). `fill` paints the parts of a layer that a front layer hides, so they can be uncovered when limbs move. Bones: pivot in source px, parent bone. Weight rules: `chain` (soft weights along a joint chain) and `region` (polygon with a feathered edge) are applied in order on top of the layer's default `bone`.

puppets.use: Hero: seated on the giant finger, typing on the MacBook in the render (no 3D laptop while this shows).
Hero: closes the MacBook on his lap, eyes lifting (between typing and rising).
Hero: rising off the finger, the closed MacBook held at his side.
Selected Work: flying between projects (mirrored for right-to-left flights).
Workspace: walking in from the left (profile, facing right). Cut-out layers for a scroll-scrubbed walk cycle.
Workspace: the render's chair, desk, monitor, keyboard and mug are the set (the procedural 3D desk is hidden); the seated character is its own layer.
